Since git-commit-scoped.sh stages a whole named path (no sub-file hunk granularity), committing index-entries.json under task 483 would over-stage those 3 unrelated hunks into this task's history. Left the corrected content in the working tree (satisfies this phase's own doc-lint verification, which reads the working tree directly) but did not commit the file under task 483; its own line_count fix will land whenever a later commit (this task's or another's) covers that path.
